identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of GNC-038, a Tetra-specific Antibody, in Participants With R/R Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma (DLBCL)
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-Label, Multi-Center, Phase Ib/II Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability and Pharmacokinetic Characteristics of Tetra-specific Antibody GNC-038 in Participants With Recurrent or Refractory Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma (DLBCL)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: In this study, the safety and preliminary efficacy of GNC-038 in participants with recurrent or refractory Diffuse Large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) will be investigated to assess the dose-limiting toxicity (DLT), maximum tolerated dose (MTD) or maximum administered dose (MAD) for MTD is not reached of GNC-038. The recommended dose for phase II (RP2D) clinical study will also be determined.

armGroups.label: Study treatment
armGroups.description: Participants receive GNC-038 as intravenous infusion for the first cycle (3 weeks). Participants with clinical benefit could receive additional treatment for more cycles. The administration will be terminated because of disease progression or intolerable toxicity occurring or other reasons.

primaryOutcomes.description: The incidence and severity of adverse events during treatment were graded according to the National Cancer Institute Standard for Common Terminology for Adverse Events (NCI-CTCAE, v5.0).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 21 days after the first dose of GNC-038

primaryOutcomes.measure: Maximum tolerated dose (MTD) or maximum administrated dose (MAD)
primaryOutcomes.description: In the dose increment stage, the highest dose whose estimated DLT rate is closest to the target DLT rate but does not exceed the upper bound of the equivalent interval of DLT rate is selected as MTD.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 21 days after the first dose of GNC-038

primaryOutcomes.description: TEAE is defined as any unfavorable and unintended change in the structure, function, or chemistry of the body temporally emerging, or any worsening (i.e., any clinically significant adverse change in frequency and/or intensity) of a pre-existing condition during the treatment of GNC-038. The type, frequency and severity of TEAE will be evaluated during the treatment of GNC-038.

primaryOutcomes.measure: The recommended dose for phase II clinical study（RP2D）
primaryOutcomes.description: The RP2D is defined as the dose level chosen by the sponsor (in consultation with the investigators) for phase II study, based on safety, tolerability, efficacy, PK, and PD data collected during the dose escalation study of GNC-038.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 21 days after the first dose of GNC-038

secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the percentage of participants, who has a CR (disappearance of all target lesions) or PR (at least a 30% decrease in the sum of diameters of target lesions). The percentage of participants who experiences a confirmed CR or PR is according to RECIST 1.1.
The PFS is defined as the time from the participant's first dose of GNC-038 to the first date of either disease progression or death, whichever occurs first.

The DCR is defined as the percentage of participants who has a CR, PR, or Stable Disease (SD: neither sufficient shrinkage to qualify for PR nor sufficient increase to qualify for progressive disease \[PD: at least a 20% increase in the sum of diameters of target lesions and an absolute increase of at least 5 mm. The appearance of one or more new lesions is also considered PD\]).
The DOR for a responder is defined as the time from the participant's initial objective response to the first date of either disease progression or death, whichever occurs first.
AESI is an event of scientific and medical interest specific to the sponsor's product or research project.
Maximum serum concentration (Cmax) of GNC-038 will be investigated.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 21 days after the first dose of GNC-038

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and titer of ADA (Anti-drug antibody)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Frequency and titer of anti-GNC-038 antibody (ADA) will be evaluated.
Incidence and titer of Nab of GNC-038 will be evaluated.
Concentration of GNC-038 at steady state plateau will be investigated.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 14 days after the first dose of GNC-038

secondaryOutcomes.description: Time to maximum serum concentration (Tmax) of GNC-038 will be investigated.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 21 days after the first dose of GNC-038

secondaryOutcomes.description: Area under the plasma concentration-time curve from time 0 extrapolated to infinite (AUC0-inf).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 21 days after the first dose of GNC-038

secondaryOutcomes.description: Area under the plasma concentration-time curve from time 0 to last time of quantifiable concentration (AUC0-t).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 21 days after the first dose of GNC-038

secondaryOutcomes.description: To study the serum clearance rate of GNC-038 per unit time.
